item.title: Cost of Living in Clayton South Melbourne

Is Clayton South Expensive?

Clayton South sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Clayton South, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.
